_comment: Chromium managed policy for the Vajron GCS kiosk. Installed to /etc/chromium/policies/managed/. Confines the browser to the GCS itself: even if someone exits kiosk mode, there is nowhere else to browse, no devtools, no incognito, and no way to edit these settings from the UI.
_comment_updates: No update nags or auto-restarts mid-flight.
_comment_allowlist: localhost:8080 page, :8082 bridge, :8889 camera (MediaMTX WebRTC). server.arcgisonline.com: satellite map tiles -- only reachable if the Pi has internet; without it the map still shows positions and route. Change with MAP_TILES in src/config.ts.
